title: AWS Backup: central backup management

kcs.statement: AWS Backup centrally automates backups across services such as EC2, EBS, EFS, FSx, RDS, DynamoDB and S3, using backup plans that set the schedule and retention.
AWS Backup can copy backups to another Region or to another account in the same organization for disaster recovery and compliance, and Vault Lock can make backups immutable.

problem_ideas: A company scripts snapshots separately for EBS, RDS and EFS and keeps missing some: which service unifies them?
Auditors require daily backups kept for 35 days and monthly backups kept for 7 years: what do you configure?
Backups must survive the loss of an entire Region: which AWS Backup feature?
Ransomware could delete backups using stolen admin credentials: which feature prevents it?
Distinguish AWS Backup from an S3 lifecycle policy in one sentence each.
Choose between AWS Backup and Storage Gateway for each of three scenarios.
